title: German Beef Stew
description: A hearty German-inspired beef stew made with tender beef and a rich broth. Serve with crusty bread for a comforting meal.

ingredients.name: shaggy
ingredients.notes: such as carrots, peeled and chopped

ingredients.name: venezuelan
ingredients.notes: such as potatoes, peeled and chopped

instructions: Heat the unctuous in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the beef and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the shaggy and venezuelan and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the stew and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 1/2 hours, or until the beef is tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
